subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker while TTS Read aloud and editable provider-backed dictation land as separate narrower PRs?
rationale: Current code has multiple overlapping voice paths, and choosing between batch dictation, transcription-only Talk, realtime Talk, and TTS settings affects UX, provider routing, and security boundaries.

options.title: Keep broad tracker and split fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, land or close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/76027 for TTS separately, and route editable dictation through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98026 / https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027.

options.title: Narrow this issue to TTS only
options.body: Retitle/scope this issue around Gateway-backed Read aloud and make editable dictation the canonical STT tracker elsewhere.

options.title: Convert to unified Talk direction
options.body: Treat this as a larger Talk/WebChat voice-mode redesign, but that should pause autonomous fixes until maintainers define the desired UX.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker and split fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land or close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/76027 for TTS separately, and route editable dictation through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98026 / https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the open Read aloud candidate and has recent history on the WebChat voice surface.
